optimizedDescription.value: CompileContext assembles project context and spec entries for a change step from include rules, deps, and metadata.

optimizedContext.value:
# CompileContext

## Rules

### Ports
- Inject `ChangeRepository`, `ListWorkspaces`, `SchemaProvider`, `FileReader`, `ArtifactParserRegistry`, `ContentHasher`, `PreviewSpec`, `GetSpecMetadata`, baked `CompileContextConfig`.
- `defaultConfig` from resolved `SpecdConfig` at kernel time: project `context`, `contextIncludeSpecs`, `contextExcludeSpecs`, per-workspace patterns, `projectRoot`, `configPath`. MUST NOT bake per-call `contextMode` or `llmOptimizedContext` unless they are yaml defaults.
- `SchemaProvider` lazy-caching resolved schema. `PreviewSpec` = merged view with validated deltas. `ContentHasher` for fingerprint. `GetSpecMetadata` `policy: "if-needed"` replaces direct `SpecRepository.metadata()` freshness checks.
- MUST NOT accept `LifecycleEngine` or `ImplementationDetector`, evaluate readiness, or autodetect implementation. MUST NOT call `SpecRepository.readMetadataSnapshot()`.

### Input
- `name`; `step` (entry point only — no readiness). Optional: `contextMode` `list|summary|full|hybrid`; `llmOptimizedContext`; `includeChangeSpecs` default `false`; `followDeps` default `false`; `depth` only with `followDeps` (1 = direct); `sections` `rules|constraints|scenarios` (full mode only); `fingerprint`.
- MUST NOT accept `config`. Yaml config is the construction snapshot.
- Start of `execute`: shallow-merge baked config with input overrides for `contextMode` and `llmOptimizedContext` only. Other fields stay baked. Hosts pass runtime overrides only.
- Match fingerprint → `status: "unchanged"`, empty `projectContext` and `specs`. Else `status: "changed"` plus full context and new fingerprint.
- Assemble from persisted tracked implementation state. Callers that need fresh files call `RefreshImplementationTracking` first.

### Schema and workspaces
- `schema.name()` vs `change.schemaName` mismatch → `SchemaMismatchError` before collection.
- Explicit spec qualifier (`billing:auth/login`) selects workspace. Unqualified: project include/exclude → `default`; workspace include/exclude → that workspace; `dependsOn` → declaring spec's workspace.
- Unknown workspace from `ListWorkspaces` → warning and skip. No throw.

### Collection
- Seed before steps 1–5: every `change.specIds` only if `includeChangeSpecs: true` (mandatory; survive later excludes); every value in `change.specDependsOn`.
- Then `resolveConfiguredContextSpecs` from `core:resolve-context-specs`. MUST NOT re-implement glob order. Helper MUST NOT own seeding, protected `specIds`, or step 5.
  1. Project include patterns.
  2. Project excludes, except mandatory seeds.
  3. Workspace includes only for workspaces active via `change.specIds`.
  4. Workspace excludes for active workspaces, except mandatory seeds.
  5. Only if `followDeps: true`: from `change.specIds`, three-tier `dependsOn`, transitive until done or `depth`. Not gated on `ready`. Traversal additions NOT subject to excludes. Absent/false → skip step 5.
- `useOptimizedProjectContext`: still call helper for workspace patterns, but pass empty project include/exclude so steps 1–2 skip and 3–4 run. Exclude callbacks MUST refuse to drop protected seeds.
- Traversal existence check against workspace `SpecRepository` BEFORE register. Unresolvable discoveries skipped silently (no warning). Warnings later via seeding or rendering.
- Persisted spec metadata cannot materialize during traversal → `missing-metadata` warning; continue with `specDependsOn` or schema `metadataExtraction.dependsOn` when declared. Non-persisted specs do not warn merely for lacking persisted state.
- Stale metadata: keep persisted canonical result, emit `stale-metadata`, apply dep rules. Do not treat stale as missing.
- Dedup. First matching include position wins. Traversal specs already included stay at earlier position.

### dependsOn order
1. `change.specDependsOn[specId]` before any repository access.
2. `GetSpecMetadata.execute({ specId })` self-healing normalized deps.
3. Schema `metadataExtraction.dependsOn` only when materialization cannot produce a projection and schema declares it. Shared extractor-transform registry + caller origin bag. Change-scoped specs extract over merged preview; others over base persisted artifacts.
- First non-empty tier wins. All empty → no deps.
- Cycle: stop repeated edge; include reachable specs. No user-facing warning for the cycle alone.

### Display modes
- After collection, before render. Absent `contextMode` → `summary`.
- `list`: id, source, mode. No description/content. `sections` ignored.
- `summary`: id, title, description, source, mode. No full content. For `change.specIds`, title/description from schema extraction over merged preview, else canonical metadata. `sections` ignored.
- `full`: full content; `sections` restrict metadata sections.
- `hybrid`: `change.specIds` with `includeChangeSpecs: true` are full; others summary. `sections` only on full entries.

### Extracted-first for change-scoped specs
- For collected IDs in `change.specIds`, every mode except `list`: `PreviewSpec` merged set (persisted + validated deltas, including change-only files) is PRIMARY. Same in summary, full, hybrid.
- Title, description, section content via schema `metadataExtraction` over merged set. No markdown H1 heuristics as primary.
- Ladder: (1) extraction over merged preview; (2) canonical `GetSpecMetadata` when preview unavailable, no files, or no usable fields; (3) extraction over base persisted set when no merged view and canonical unusable.
- While any rung yields usable data, no `stale-metadata` or `missing-metadata`. Change-only specs compile without persisted metadata.
- Lock-owned LLM optimizations MUST NOT apply to `change.specIds`.

### Staleness and content
- Included specs outside `change.specIds`: `GetSpecMetadata` `'if-needed'` for summary fields and section-filtered full content. Never read `SpecRepository.metadata()` and judge freshness itself.
- Materialize only specs actually rendered, after display-mode classification.
- `source: "persisted"` `regenerated: false` → use content. `regenerated: true` or source-conflict retry → use in-memory projection. Regeneration is provenance, not a warning. Forward only actionable failures such as `metadata-cache-write-failed`.
- No valid projection (no `metadataExtraction` and empty generation) → `missing-metadata` and empty/minimal entry. Do not throw. Do not fire while extracted-first ladder still yields data.
- `sections` absent: full body from ordered spec-scoped artifact files; metadata not required for body. Projection may still supply summary fields.
- `PreviewSpec` errors MUST NOT block compilation; fall back to base content.

### Result
- `projectContext`: declaration order. `instruction` verbatim; `file` relative to `specd.yaml` dir via `FileReader`. Missing file → warning, skip. Shape `{ source: "instruction"|"file", path?, content }`.
- `specs` stable order: direct `change.specIds` seeds (when included), then `specDependsOn` seeds, then include-pattern declaration order, then traversal discoveries.
- Entry: `specId`, `title`/`description` (summary/full), `source` `specIds|specDependsOn|includePattern|dependsOnTraversal` (priority `specIds` > `specDependsOn` > `dependsOnTraversal` > `includePattern`), `mode` `list|summary|full`, `content` only when `full`.
- Full, no `sections`: all `scope: spec` artifacts. `spec.md` first if present, then remaining filenames alphabetical. Concatenate and label each filename. Change specs use `PreviewSpec` order when available, else base set.
- Full with `sections`: selected metadata sections only, not raw files. Change specs extract selected sections from merged preview when available. Others from fresh metadata or base extraction.
- Result: `contextFingerprint`, `status` `changed|unchanged`, `projectContext`, `specs`, `warnings`. MUST NOT include lifecycle state, step availability, blocking artifacts, or per-step availability. Use `GetStatus`.
- Include-pattern or non-traversal missing spec → warning and skip. Traversal misses stay silent. Seeded refs that reach rendering warn when no content source resolves.

### Fingerprint
- From canonicalized emitted logical context: project entries, spec entries, diagnostics, result-shaping inputs that change emitted entries. No lifecycle state/availability/blockers. `step` affects fingerprint only when it changes emitted context (e.g. section selection).
- Delta edits change change-scoped merged entries and fingerprint. Cached `unchanged` MUST NOT survive delta modifications.

### LLM-optimized context
- `llmOptimizedContext: true`: prefer non-empty `optimizedContext`; else standard `context`.
- Strict bypass: forced off if `sections` is passed and does not include both `rules` and `constraints`. If `scenarios` requested while optimized context active, still extract and append scenarios. `optimizedDescription` preference unaffected.
- Change-scope bypass: `change.specIds` never use `optimizedContext` or `optimizedDescription`. Independent of sections bypass; every display mode.
- Warnings only for collected specs NOT in `change.specIds`: `missing-optimization` (no value) vs `stale-optimization` (baselines drifted). Both messages MUST include `Launch specd-spec-context-optimizer agent to refresh`. Change specs MUST NOT produce optimization warnings.

### Factory
- `createCompileContext(config, options?)` → `resolveCompileContextDeps(resolver)` → canonical deps. Resolver: `changes`, `listWorkspaces`, `schemaProvider`, `files`, `parsers`, `hasher`, `previewSpec`, `getMetadata`, `extractorTransforms`, `workspaceRoutes`, `defaultConfig`. MUST NOT resolve `LifecycleEngine`. No inline fs wiring.

## Constraints

- Project context entries precede spec entries.
- Missing context files warn and skip.
- Steps 1–4 before traversal. Traversal additions survive excludes.
- At most one entry per spec; highest-priority source.
- No direct filesystem reads. Spec files/metadata via `SpecRepository`; `config.context` files via `FileReader`. Caller constructs repositories, readers, and config.
- Active workspace list covers every `specd.yaml` workspace; missing workspace warns.
- No artifact instructions, rules, or delta context. Use `GetArtifactInstruction`. No `instruction:` hooks. Use `GetHookInstructions`.
- `followDeps` opt-in. `depth` meaningful only with `followDeps`.
- `sections` only affect full content.
- Cycle safety mandatory.
- Outside `change.specIds`: prefer fresh canonical metadata; `metadataExtraction` fallback only when metadata absent or stale. Inside: extracted-first over merged preview, canonical metadata as fallback.
- Default mode `summary`. Hybrid full only for direct `change.specIds` when `includeChangeSpecs: true`.
- `PreviewSpec` errors always fall back; never block compilation.
